basis: Orofacial cleft affects oral structures; the supplied evidence does not establish a separate skeletal lesion.

decisions.musculoskeletal: none: facial-skeleton ancestry alone does not establish bony involvement in this unspecified cleft subtype.

basis: MS, ichthyosis and coagulation deficiency define it; optic atrophy/neuritis occurs in 80-99%. Immune mechanism omitted at the four-axis cap.

decisions.ocular: involved: optic atrophy and retrobulbar optic neuritis occur in 80-99%, establishing direct optic nerve damage.
decisions.dermatologic: primary: lamellar ichthyosis is a defining component, reported in 80-99%.
decisions.infectious_immune: none: MS is immune-mediated, but the four-axis cap prioritizes the defining affected organs and very frequent optic nerve damage.

basis: Parathyroid hyperfunction; osteoporosis/osteopenia occur in 80-99%. Nephrocalcinosis does not establish functional impairment; renal insufficiency occurs in 5-29%.

decisions.renal: none: nephrocalcinosis is reported in 80-99%, but function-impairing renal involvement is not established at 30%; renal insufficiency occurs in 5-29%.

basis: Neurodevelopmental syndrome; posterior pituitary hypoplasia occurs in 30-79%. Eye and digital findings lack established functional damage; renal agenesis occurs in 5-29%.

decisions.ocular: none: nonspecific eye abnormalities occur in 30-79%, but do not establish damaging lesions; specified strabismus occurs in 5-29%.
decisions.musculoskeletal: none: tapered digits, cutaneous syndactyly and unspecified foot/toe morphology do not establish skeletal injury or locomotor dysfunction.

basis: Cortisol excess directly causes myopathy in roughly 40-70% and skin atrophy/fragility in over 50%; associated hypertension is a separate diagnosis.

decisions.cardiovascular: none: hypertension affects roughly 70-80%, but is separately diagnosed; direct cardiac or vascular injury is not established in at least 30%.

basis: Mitochondrial metabolic disorder; developmental impairment and muscle weakness occur in 2/2, with documented brain injury. Ophthalmoplegia does not establish intrinsic eye damage.

decisions.ocular: none: external ophthalmoplegia (1/1) reflects extraocular muscle or neural dysfunction; nystagmus does not establish intrinsic eye injury.

basis: Cleft palate, microcephaly and skeletal growth defects define it; ptosis occurs in 30-79%. Nail hypoplasia omitted at cap; renal damage frequency unknown.

decisions.ocular: involved: ptosis represents eyelid dysfunction and occurs in 30-79%.
decisions.musculoskeletal: primary: defining prenatal short stature and skeletal abnormalities; delayed skeletal maturation occurs in 80-99%, muscle atrophy in 30-79%.

basis: Disproportionate skeletal growth, valvular disease and abnormal dentition define it; ptosis occurs in 80-99%. Three defining axes occupy the primary tier.

decisions.gastrointestinal: primary: abnormal dentition and high palate are explicitly defining features; dentition abnormalities and dental crowding occur in 80-99%.

basis: Congenital cardiac and splenic defects define heterotaxy; asplenia occurs in 7/12. Anal atresia occurs in 1/2, supporting GI involvement with limited sampling.

decisions.haematologic: primary: splenic absence/malformation is a defining heterotaxy feature; asplenia occurs in 7/12 and eliminates splenic function.

basis: Ingested preformed botulinum toxin blocks neuromuscular and autonomic transmission; ocular, swallowing and respiratory findings reflect neural dysfunction.

decisions.infectious_immune: none: foodborne botulism is intoxication by preformed toxin, rather than infection or an immune-mediated disease; broad infectious ancestry does not override its definition.
